nodes.text:
Not only Moderna, but also BioNTech and CureVac are now developing mRNA-based RSV vaccines. Their curiosity extends beyond RSV, as they are also working on mRNA vaccines for cancer, herpes, influenza, tropical diseases, HMPV, chikungunya, Zika, HPV, Mpox, and Ebola.

Medical scientists are medical brainwashers. Regardless of their past knowledge, common sense does not apply to them. They are driven by intellectual curiosity and have a constant desire to try the latest technologies. Since they bear no responsibility for failure, they can learn from their mistakes and continue their mission of creating ineffective poisons.
